comment: Sheet3 #73. Source of truth for health/readiness coverage. tools/health-readiness/check.mjs verifies every claim against the compose files, the rules and the runbook; a service in a compose file that is missing here fails the check.

api-blue.readiness: GET /ready (primary DB + Redis, 2 s deadline each)

worker.readiness: same heartbeat (needs Redis; the API /ready also reports workers and outbox)

postgres.test: live: DB fault proxy in script-testing/health-readiness

redis.test: live: Redis fault proxy in script-testing/health-readiness

backup.gap: container turns unhealthy but nothing pages: needs a backup-age metric

migrate.exempt: one-shot job: depends_on service_completed_successfully is its health gate

probe.exempt: no healthcheck: RuntimeMetricsTargetDown fires when crm-probe stops being scraped

prometheus.exempt: monitoring plane; its image has no shell tools used here. Nothing watches the watcher: see gaps

grafana.exempt: dashboards only, not on the request path

virtual.realtime-gateway: runs inside the API process: covered by the api-blue/api-green rows (no separate container)
virtual.traefik: external (dokploy), not in these compose files: routes /health and /ready to the API (traefik-desk.yml.template); its own health is outside this repo
virtual.s3-object-storage: external Cloudflare R2: deliberately NOT part of /ready (an R2 outage must not pull the API from rotation); no probe exists, see gaps
